import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem linearMap_comap_iInf_composition {F V W X : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [AddCommGroup X] [Field F] [Module F V] [Module F W] [Module F X]
    {ι : Type*} (f : V →ₗ[F] W) (g : W →ₗ[F] X) (u : ι → Submodule F X) :
    ∃ U : Submodule F V,
      U = ((⨅ i, u i).comap g).comap f ∧
      U = (⨅ i, u i).comap (g.comp f) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ U ↔ ∀ i, g (f x) ∈ u i) ∧
      ∀ S : Submodule F V, (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i, g (f x) ∈ u i) → S ≤ U := by
  refine ⟨((⨅ i, u i).comap g).comap f, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext x
    simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  · intro x
    simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.mem_iInf]
  · intro S h x hx
    simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.mem_iInf]
    exact h x hx
